Attribute cohort papers to the trajectory that carries them forward

Source: R/sniff_trajectory_destination.R
dot-assign_destination_trajectory.Rd

For each cohort paper, finds the trajectory (across all groups) whose nodes contain it in the most years after the death year. The source trajectory, whose nodes all fall on or before the death year, is excluded automatically.

Usage

.assign_destination_trajectory(
  cohort,
  terminal_year,
  all_detected,
  docs_per_group,
  exclude_key = NULL
)

Arguments

cohort

Character vector of document ids.

terminal_year

Death year of the source trajectory.

all_detected

Named list of detect_main_trajectories() outputs.

docs_per_group

Per-year membership tibble.

exclude_key

Optional trajectory key(s) ("group::traj_id") to skip.

Value

Tibble document_id, dest_traj_key, dest_group, dest_traj_id, with "(none)" for papers that no trajectory carries past the death year.
